name: allocation-api

dependencies.name: resend
dependencies.description: Sends email notifications for allocation-request and allocation-decision events.

description: Owns customers, engagements, staffing plans, the team member directory, allocation requests, and allocations. Exposes REST endpoints for creating/managing customers and engagements, submitting and reviewing allocation requests, assigning/modifying allocations, and reporting utilization. Sends email notifications via Resend on request/decision events. Does not render any UI and does not issue its own auth tokens — the gateway validates tokens issued by Thunder.
